programmes.d: Bakura and Marik duel for control of the Millennium Rod and the Millennium Ring.
Bakura summons a winged dragon in preparation for a battle with evil Marik.
When Noah drives the blimp off its course and into a virtual world, Yugi and his friends are forced to duel the Big Five or be trapped in the cyber world forever.
Left on his own, Yugi must learn the new rules of dueling in the virtual world.
Seto and Mokuba must face their past when they visit the orphanage where they once lived.
Yugi learns the new rules to dueling as he battles Big One.
Tea is taken to a penguin continent where she is forced to duel the Nightmare Penguin.
Yugi is transported to the virtual ice field where Tea duels Big Two, in the form of the Nightmare Penguin.
Joey finds himself in a difficult courtroom duel against Big Three; Kaiba is tormented by the virtual recreations of his memories.
Big Three plays by his own rules, tricking Joey and causing him to fall behind in the duel.
Serenity, Duke and Tristan meet up with Big Four, who challenges all three of them to a duel.
Tristan disappears into a lake of fire after his life points are wiped out; Serenity and Duke battle Big Four.
Tristan's mind is trapped in a robot monkey; Kaiba runs into Big 5.
Kaiba must use his most powerful monster, Blue-Eyes White Dragon, against the Big Five; Tristan is still trapped inside the robot monkey.
Kaiba arrives at Noah's sanctuary to rescue Mokuba, who has been manipulated and wants to stay with Noah.
Yugi and Joey face the Big Five.
The Big Five concentrate their attack on Joey in hopes of knocking him out; the Big Five keep switching their Deck Masters to take advantage of each of their unique abilities.
Joey and Yugi battle the Big Five and their Five God Dragon, hoping to defeat them and save Tristan's body.
Noah and Kaiba agree to battle for control of the corporation.
Noah summons dinosaur monsters to do battle with Kaiba's interdimensional dragon.
Mokuba's actions put his relationship with Kaiba in jeopardy.
Yugi takes Kaiba's place in a duel against Noah.
Yugi's friends try to support him during a duel, despite being turned into stone.
After defeating Noah, Yugi learns why he cannot escape from the virtual world.
Yugi and gang are trapped in an underwater base about to be destroyed by a satellite; the gang must rely on help from an enemy, Noah, in order to defeat a horde of monsters.
Yugi and his friends must find a way to escape from the virtual world.
The gang arrives at KaibaCorp Island, and the Battle City finals begin with a four-person duel.
A four-way duel involves secret motives and strategies, where anything is possible and attacks come from all directions.
Joey uses his fierce skills during the conclusion of the four-man duel.
Marik and Joey feel the pain of their monsters while they duel.
Marik's Helpoemer sends Joey's powerful cards to the graveyard.
Joey must prevent Marik from summoning the Egyptian God card.
Joey must endure the inferno of flames to free Mai from her mental prison.
Yugi and Kaiba battle.
Yugi tries to summon the Egyptian God card first.
For the first time ever, two Egyptian God cards battle.
A battle between two Egyptian God Cards releases mystical forces and visions that answer questions and create prophecies.
Kaiba summons three powerful dragons, and Yugi has no monsters to withstand them.
Yugi's effort to save the world is complicated with Kaiba controlling the powerful Blue Eyes Ultimate Dragon.
A new mystery card determines the outcome of Joey's battle against Kaiba.
Kaiba is duped by Joey's "dragon switcheroo trick."
Junouchi hopes to turn the tables on Kaiba by using his baby dragon/time wizard combo.
Yugi stands between Marik and his desire to rule the world.
The final Battle City duel continues.
During the concluding duel, Marik assaults unconscious Odion with some shocking words.
Yugi's chances of winning the duel are getting worse.
Yugi's monsters must defeat a powerful Egyptian God card.
Yugi and his friends must stop KaibaCorp island from exploding.
Tea and Serenity explore the town of Domino and reminisce about battles.
